realities.question: What if I started my own restaurant?
realities.description: You are considering opening your own restaurant. I assumed a small independent place and that you would compare opening it with keeping your current situation.
questions: How much could you sell per month in your area?
What would rent and ingredients cost?
How much money can you put in before opening?
